viewoption:hotkeysTitle: Single-key shortcuts for these settings and Listen
viewoption:ttsNoVoices: No voices found. Listen reads aloud with the text-to-speech voices installed on your device - add a voice in your system's speech settings, then reload the page.
viewoption:ttsNoscript: Please enable javascript to listen to this text. It reads aloud in your browser with your device's own voices, via the SpeechSynthesis API, and most of them work offline.
viewoption:voiceInfoOnline: Voices marked {online} send the text to the company that makes them, such as Google or Microsoft. The rest read it on your device.
viewoption:voiceInfoSource: These voices all come from your device and browser. Higher quality voices are usually a free download in your system's speech or accessibility settings. Remember to reload the page after adding new ones.
